title: 2023年12月六级写作：老年人对社会的贡献
prompt:
续写作文：以下列句子开头写一篇文章："With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society." 可以发表评论、举例或结合个人经历展开。（150-200词）

开头句：With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society.
